role: Single quality gate for optical (Verity Sense) PPI intervals used by both the live stream and offline downloads: blocker bit, error estimate <= 20 ms, and 300–2000 ms range; plus offline PPI → RRPoint conversion.

units.does: Returns ppInMs when blockerBit == 0, ppErrorEstimate <= 20 and ppInMs within the accepted range; else nil.
units.entry: Called from PolarManager.ingestPpi (PolarManager+Streaming.swift:129) and rrPoints; tests StrapPPIFilterTests.

branches.cond: blocker bit clear and error <= 20 ms

units.does: Converts offline PPI samples to RRPoints, keeping only accepted intervals; t_ms accumulates only accepted beats, points carry no wallClockMs.

branches.effect: true: skipped with no elapsed time added; false: appended at cumulative time

flags.text: The doc says the compressed t_ms is safe because 'the window selector translates through wallClockMs', but these points are built with RRPoint(t_ms:rr_ms:), which sets wallClockMs = nil, so the selector falls back to t_ms (closestIndex uses wallClockMs ?? t_ms). Every rejected optical interval shortens a Verity offline night's timeline, so sleep-boundary/window placement and StrapRecording.endedAt (start + sum of accepted beats) land earlier than real time by the total rejected duration.
